summary: Google Cloud's AI startup program grants up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits over two years for eligible AI-first, VC-funded startups (Grow/Scale tier). Year 1 is 100% up to $100,000 generally, or 100% up to $250,000 for AI-first startups; Year 2 covers only 20% of usage up to an additional $100,000 in credits. The company pays all uncovered or excess charges, including the uncovered share in Year 2; Google need not notify it when credits are exhausted. Credits may be issued incrementally at Google's discretion. Coupon redemption deadlines are communicated in writing; credit-expiry dates are specified in writing at issuance or shown in the console/dashboard. Credits cover Google models such as Gemini and Gemma; third-party models are billed directly and are not covered. Eligibility is selection-based: Pre-Seed/Seed within the last five years or Series A within the last 12 months, founded within five years, not yet received more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits, and at Google Cloud's discretion. The AI program also requires using or planning to use Gemini to deploy AI services as a foundation of the primary product or solution. This is distinct from the $300 Free Trial listing. The current general program FAQ requires an active business website, a matching business-email domain, and the selected Google Cloud account/billing ID to be owned and administered by a user on that company domain. Prepare the 18-character billing account ID and confirm it is attached to the projects receiving credits. Credits apply only to eligible Google-owned/built first-party products billed on a pay-as-you-go or consumption basis; subscription, prepay and annual-license products, and all third-party Marketplace/Model Garden products, are excluded. The FAQ requires self-service purchasing in a GA region and says businesses involving a regulated industry or sector are not eligible; confirm your business category with Google before relying on an award.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: VC-funded startup using or planning to use Gemini as a foundation of its primary product/solution; Pre-Seed/Seed raised within five years or Series A within 12 months, founded within five years, and no more than $5,000 prior Google Cloud credits.

Prepare an active business website, matching-domain business email and company-domain-administered Google Cloud account/billing ID. Check the selected 18-character billing ID belongs to your startup and is linked to the projects you intend to use.

Check current general-program eligibility: self-service purchasing in a GA region is required; its FAQ excludes businesses involving regulated industries/sectors. Confirm your category with Google before relying on credits.
Apply at cloud.google.com/startup/ai (selection-based; acceptance is at Google Cloud's discretion).

Use credits only on eligible Google-owned/built first-party PAYG or consumption-billed products, including covered Google models. Subscription, prepay, annual-license and all third-party Marketplace/Model Garden products are excluded.
Year 2 covers only 20% of usage up to an additional $100,000 in credits. Your company pays all uncovered or excess charges, including the uncovered Year 2 share.
Credits may be issued incrementally at Google's discretion. Follow written coupon-redemption deadlines and check credit-expiry dates in the written award or console/dashboard.
Monitor usage and credit balances: Google is not required to notify you when credits are exhausted. Stop unwanted billable usage to avoid ongoing costs.
Do not confuse this with the separate $300 Google Cloud Free Trial.

social_proof.title: Google Cloud Startups Program — credit billing terms
social_proof.text: Company will be responsible for all Service usage fees or charges not covered by, or in excess of, the credits, and Google is not required to notify Company when the credit is exhausted.

social_proof.title: Current startup FAQ — credit product restrictions
social_proof.text: Offer applies solely to Google-owned and built first-party (1P) Google Cloud Platform products billed on a pay-as-you-go (PayG) or consumption basis. All 1P products billed through subscription, pre-pay, or annual license are excluded, as are all third-party (3P) products and services, including any 3P offerings listed in Google Cloud Marketplace or Model Garden.
